title: Приступ радикулита и бездомный котёнок  (A Bout of Sciatica and a Stray Kitten)

segments.t: During their second morning run in the park, Chef Barinov is on the verge of collapsing when Elena suddenly throws her back out and cannot move an inch. Meanwhile back at the apartment, Max and Kostya hatch a clever plan using a stray kitten to appeal to Nastya's soft heart.
Не могу ни туда, ни сюда.
Вы меня не шевелите, я сама, ладно?
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'You got here fast.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'quickly' and finishing on 'you'. Max answers right away.
'What is wrong with you?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'what' before landing on 'with you'.
'What happened to your back?' Rodion anchors the line on 'what', while 'back' completes the thought.
'I cannot move.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'can' to negate the statement. Rodion answers right away.
Не могу ни туда, ни сюда.
'I cannot move forward or backward.' The grammar packs 'not' and 'here' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Hold on, stop, stop.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'stop' and finishing on 'stop'.
'Wait, hold still.' Rodion brings out the contrast between 'stop' and 'stop' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
Вы меня не шевелите, я сама, ладно?
'Do not move me, I will try by myself, okay?' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'to move' to negate the statement.
'I can do it myself.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'myself' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Bless you.' Max anchors the line on 'be', while 'healthy' completes the thought. Rodion answers right away.
'Rodion Sergeyevich, what happened?' In Russian, the idea of 'Rodion' flows naturally into 'to happen' without extra filler words.
'Are you feeling worse?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'for you' before landing on 'worse'.
'What a sweet little kitten.' The grammar packs 'what' and 'good' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Не могу ни туда, ни сюда.
Вы меня не шевелите, я сама, ладно?
